claim: Under the remark “There are in many cases approximate paraphrases in which duration is expressed by an NP in object function”, [3ib] I reached the summit in two hours is paired with [4ib] It took me an hour to reach the summit.
evidence_summary: The other three pairs keep their measure: six years ([3ia], [4ia]), all year ([3iia], [4iia]) and two days ([3iib], [4iib]). Ch. 3, p. 122, pairs [18iia] It took him an hour to reach the summit / die with [18iiia] He reached the summit in an hour.
finding: Low to medium confidence: “approximate” may excuse a loose paraphrase. Align the durations; the text doesn’t show which number was intended.

evidence.passage: §7.2, p. 703 [3ib], [4ib]. “There are in many cases approximate paraphrases”.
evidence.establishes: The paraphrase changes two hours to one.
evidence.note: Local source (working note, unpublished draft or local copy); not online.
